messages:
Alex: Heads-up — we've got an escalated support ticket where invoices are rejected by the customer's AP team because the PDF doesn't show the legal entity registration number in the header. Customer uses PO-based billing and the payment gateway is declining until the PO matches the invoice header. :warning:

Tanya: Do we have a repro or a sample invoice PDF we can inspect?

Alex: Yes. Repro steps I used locally:
1) Create customer with billing_profile: {name: "Acme EU Ltd", country: "DE", legal_entity: {short_name: "Acme EU", reg_number: "DE123456789"}}
2) Create PO via /v1/purchase_orders (include po_number)
3) Generate invoice via POST /v1/invoices (billing_profile_id, include_line_items)
4) Download PDF -> customer says their AP validator fails to find reg_number in header.

Command I ran (curl):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/invoices \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"billing_profile_id":"bp_123","po_number":"PO-9987","line_items":[{"desc":"usage","qty":1,"unit_price":100}],"include_pdf":true}'
```

Mohan: Can you paste the rendered header and the generated PDF metadata (what template id it used)? Might be picking the wrong template for EU/legal headers.

Alex: Pasted a snippet of the rendered header text from the PDF extraction tool (ocr/text layer):
```
ACME EU LTD
123 Business Ave
Berlin, 10115
VAT ID: DE999999999
```

Note: the company registration number (DE123456789) is missing — we show VAT ID but not the registration number our finance customers require. The PDF template seems to map legal_entity.vat_id but not legal_entity.reg_number.

BillingBot: invoice-generation-job #inv_7f3 failed -> error: validation: required_field_missing: legal_entity.reg_number. Payload: invoice_id=inv_7f3, template_id=tpl_invoice_default_v2

Kira: Is this only for EU customers or could be any country-specific field? AP teams in APAC sometimes want business registration number too. We should keep the template generic: show both vat_id and registration number if present. :eyes:

Samir: Quick mitigation — add reg_number to the header rendering for tpl_invoice_default_v2 and push a hotfix to billing-renderer. Also add an opt-in config to include extra identity fields for PO-mode invoices. I can do the PR if we agree on field name.

Tanya: We need to check for side effects: will adding reg_number break legal entity line wrapping or overflow the address block? Also confirm PDF line-item compression logic — some customers need line items unrolled (one per physical PO line) otherwise their AP system rejects.

Mohan: On the rendering side the current template uses a single header block with these mappings:
```
header.name <- billing_profile.name
header.addr_line1 <- billing_profile.address.line1
header.city_line <- billing_profile.address.city + ", " + billing_profile.address.postal_code
header.tax_label <- legal_entity.vat_id
```
We can change to: header.tax_label_1 <- legal_entity.vat_id; header.tax_label_2 <- legal_entity.reg_number. The renderer will place both if non-empty.

Alex: Example failure from customer (copied from support ticket):
"Our finance system expects the company registration number to be displayed in the invoice header next to VAT. Because it's missing, the PO cannot be matched and payment is on hold. Please provide an updated PDF that includes \"Company Reg No.\" and the PO in the top header."

Samir: I'll open a Jira and a small PR. Proposed fields to add to template: [company_reg_number, company_short_name, company_legal_address_full]. Also adding a flag invoice_metadata.show_legal_numbers = true for PO invoices.

Tanya: Please include QA steps in the PR description. QA should verify:
- Reg number appears for DE, FR, UK profiles when present.
- No breaking of address layout when reg_number is long.
- PO number appears in header and in metadata OCR-friendly text layer.
- Line item detail toggle: compact vs expanded (for customers who need unrolled lines).

Mohan: Also check tax/VAT placement — if a customer has multiple legal entities mapped to a single billing profile, we need to ensure the invoice selects the correct entity per billing_profile.default_entity_id. That has bitten us before.

BillingBot: New PR required: billing-renderer#452 opened by Samir. Linked Jira: BILL-7893. Priority: P1 (customer onhold).

Alex: Customer impacted: acme-eu (account id acct_88). They've paused payment processing. Support has escalated to enterprise billing — needs fix in 48h if possible.

Kira: One more edge case — some countries want Tax breakdown per line item (tax_rate + tax_amount) displayed next to each line item, plus a separate VAT summary block. We should ensure the renderer supports line_item.tax_breakdown[] in the PDF JSON schema.

Samir: Agree. I'll include schema bumps in the PR and a migration script that populates tax_breakdown from existing tax_rate/tax_amount for older invoices during preview.

Tanya: Ok assign to eng-billing and set sprint-emergency. Samir/Tanya to own QA and rollback plan. @Mohan please validate template mapping and add unit tests for cases: long reg numbers, missing vat_id but present reg_number, and multiple entities.

Mohan: Will do. I added two unit tests locally and one manual verify. If all green I'll merge and cut a patch release to staging first.

Alex: Thanks everyone — please keep updates in this thread and ping me if you need a reproducer or the customer's sample invoice PDF. :thumbsup:
